editorial: Imagine waking up in a filth-ridden bathroom with a corpse by your side and a timer ticking down. You are thrust into a claustrophobic puzzle where survival requires a literal piece of yourself, stripping away the safety of traditional slasher tropes. James Wan transforms a single room into a pressure cooker of desperation through masterful pacing and a suffocating atmosphere. If you crave a psychological gauntlet that rewards your attention with a jaw-dropping finale, this is your nightmare of choice.
targetAudience: Ideal for fans of high-stakes thrillers and twisted morality plays.
